mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 0.5% indicates accommodative monetary policy that lowers discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS < 0.5% and SPX 20d returns are negative in > 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rates below 4.0% signal tight labor market conditions that boost corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE < 4.0% and SPX 20d returns are negative in > 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous GDP growth (GDPC1) and industrial production expansion (INDPRO) indicate robust economic momentum that increases corporate profitability and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: GDPC1 growth > 0.5% and INDPRO growth > 0.3% in prior quarter, but SPX 20d returns negative in > 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: Monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS > 1.0%) increase discount rates for equity valuation, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS > 1.0% and SPX 20d returns are positive in > 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: Strong housing market activity (HOUST > 1300) indicates resilient consumer demand and positive economic sentiment, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST > 1300 and SPX 20d returns are negative in > 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: Inflation exceeding 2.5% (CPIAUCSL > 2.5%) triggers expectations of aggressive monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL > 2.5% and SPX 20d returns are positive in > 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: Joint growth in employment (PAYEMS) and consumer spending (RSAFS) signals strong economic activity that increases corporate revenue growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: PAYEMS growth > 0.5% and RSAFS growth > 0.3% in prior month, but SPX 5d returns negative in > 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: Supply-constrained environments (INDPRO < 95) reduce industrial output capacity, increasing inflationary pressures and margin compression that cause negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO < 95 and SPX 20d returns are positive in > 60% of instances.
